_readme: Settings for the grant-results agent, which reads funders' emails about submitted grants and tells the owner what they say. Setup copies this to settings.json.
_grants_folder_note: The grants agent's folder. Its applications/ records say which funders to look for, and its state/email-findings.json is where findings go for the Grants app.

mail._mail_note: The owner's mailbox, read over IMAP with an app password kept in the macOS Keychain under keychain_service. Gmail: imap.gmail.com. iCloud: imap.mail.me.com. Yahoo: imap.mail.yahoo.com. Microsoft (Outlook.com, Microsoft 365) does not accept app passwords over IMAP any more and is not supported yet. For Gmail, add "[Gmail]/Spam" to folders if decisions might land there.

_platform_senders_note: Grant platforms that send email on a funder's behalf. A message from one of these counts only when it also names the funder or the program.
_retention_note: Extracted message text in state/inbox/ is deleted after this many days.
